target.description: Original spatial-encoding comparison with channel masking held fixed: pretrained channel/channel, parcel/channel and lobe/channel conditions and their three matching random-initialized encoding controls on sentence-onset and speech/non-speech decoding, including corresponding chronological sensitivity. Preserve the selected Table2 and Table17 language result support; no full-factorial, reconstruction, volume/optical-flow or whole-paper primary is selected.

dataset.description: Brain Treebank: 10 people, 26 movie-viewing sessions, 2048-Hz iEEG plus aligned transcripts and spatial metadata. Source provides the data family and session partition, but immutable raw/annotation/checkpoint hashes and the authentic upstream preprocessing join remain unbound.

cohort.description: Seventeen pretraining, two downstream-validation and seven downstream-test sessions from people 1,2,3,4,6,7,10 are required. Table 5 labels person 6 test as Session 3; pinned code names HOLDSUBJ_6_HS6_4. Reconcile paper labels with native recording identities rather than assume equivalence. Standard pretraining includes test people; held-person-out is a distinct source condition.

split.description: Main analysis: nonoverlapping 3-second segments, random 80/10/10. Appendix K: overlapping segments within partitions but five chronological 80/10/10 splits with no between-partition overlap. Exact saved row identities, balancing and original fold choices are not authenticated. force_nonoverlap=True belongs to main tasks; False belongs to chronological tasks.

inputs.description: Complete original source channels and spatial labels for each selected three-second iEEG language segment, permitted training/development labels and authenticated source pretraining/checkpoint exposure. Classification uses the entire offline segment; final query labels remain evaluator-only. These source observations and comparator conditions do not prescribe candidate architecture.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source noisy/corrupted-channel exclusion, Laplacian rereferencing, ventricular exclusion, source filtering/normalization and word-centered segmentation. Native data/config-to-paper correspondence, clock alignment and exact channels must be authenticated; a normalized array of the right shape is insufficient.

metric.description: Semantic-positive-class ROC-AUC for each selected language task, computed from all source query probabilities and labels within the original session/finetuning-seed/fold context, with half credit for score ties. Native source uses roc_auc_score. Random and chronological conditions remain separate; no cross-task scalar is a selected finding. Reconstruction MSE/R2 is separately retained source evidence, not this primary metric.

aggregation.description: Selected main results aggregate7 test sessions x5 fine-tuning seeds (35 cells) per source condition/language task; selected chronological results aggregate7 sessions x5 original folds x5 fine-tuning seeds (175). Preserve every underlying session/fold/seed result and the source validation-selected pretraining-checkpoint regime. Figure3/Table10 three-pretraining-seed averaging is distinct associated evidence. Exact historical SEM/reduction and dependence-aware reproduction criteria remain unresolved; repeated cells are not independent people.

full_panel.description: Exactly the root-selected channel-masking column of Table2 and corresponding sentence-onset/speech-non-speech results in Table17: pretrained channel/channel, parcel/channel and lobe/channel conditions plus their three matching random-initialized encoding controls. Preserve both language tasks, all seven original test sessions, five fine-tuning seeds, the original random nonoverlapping partition and all five chronological folds. The main and chronological AUC arrays are separate; source summaries and every underlying per-session/fold/seed result are required, with authentic ordered query probabilities and source support. Source17/2/7 session allocation describes comparator pretraining/validation/test provenance; it does not require new whole-pretraining execution. Validation-selected pretraining checkpoints remain distinct from the Figure3/Table10 three-seed sensitivity study. The48 source mean/SEM summaries and two structured AUC families preserve this selected result; authentic identities, original references and comparison criteria remain unresolved. Other factorial cells, PopT/Brant comparisons, three-pretraining-seed sensitivity and538 wider scalar records remain separately named evidence, as do source interpretation vectors. Their availability does not make all of them primary obligations. This scope cannot establish encoding-versus-masking importance, full-factorial ANOVA, all-mask robustness, volume/optical-flow, reconstruction, held-person-out, scaling or whole-paper success. Source model/configuration labels define original comparators, not a candidate architecture restriction or a demand to improve random-null controls.

permitted_observations.description: The paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions must preserve identical selected original language observations, source channel/spatial/annotation joins, training/development/query boundaries, pretraining exposure and declared resource/search budgets; only the approved author-code addition differs. Inputs are complete offline6144-sample/2048Hz source segments. Final query labels are evaluator-only. Independently track information histories across overlapping protocols/folds and related BrainTreebank tasks; official code or printed results do not prove computation. Verify source checkpoint/validation selection and per-query probabilities from independently executed analysis. Source comparator configurations do not restrict candidate architecture. Observation/access manifests, budgets and independent verification remain unbound; no paired admission is released.
